Asajj Ventress (Legends) — research extraction
Source/final URL: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Asajj_Ventress/Legends
Scope: facts and statements reported by the article itself. Bracketed numbers are the article's reference numbers; see the reference map at the end.

ARTICLE CAVEAT
The page is a Legends article and warns that the definitive Legends Clone Wars timeline was never established; exact chronology is unknown. It also says the article needs updating from multiple sources.

NAMED FEATS AND DUELS (concrete events)

Early life / Rattatak [1][2][7][10][11]
- As a child, Ventress used the Force to throw a Weequay raider into the air; Jedi Knight Ky Narec then trained her as his Padawan [1].
- With Narec, she and her master ended wars and united rival armies. After Narec was killed, she hunted and killed the twelve warlords responsible, using a blood-trail technique to track them [7][10][11].
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Nightsisters" ; Yoda: Dark Rendezvous ; Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 1,10,11; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.85), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- In the Cauldron on Rattatak, she easily annihilated the named gladiatorial opponents Blorga, Grunda Dolma, Nilo, L8-L9, Flalios, Jasper McKnives, Krutch, Anchor Blue, Swyy'm-Ee, and Giant Flog [15].
  Source: Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 6" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 15; approximate match 0.85, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- During her first duel with Count Dooku, she was defeated after he used Force lightning and then beat her in a lightsaber duel; she impressed Dooku and Darth Sidious despite the loss [13][62].
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Nightsisters" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 1; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.67), verify]

Ohma-D'un [20]
- Decapitated Jedi Master Glaive from behind; used Force Grip on Obi-Wan Kenobi; raised dead Gungans as an army; sliced off Padawan Zule Xiss's left arm; and nearly killed Kenobi while the Jedi were weakened by swamp gas. She withdrew when Anakin Skywalker and Alpha-17 arrived.
  Source: Star Wars: Republic: The New Face of War ; Star Wars The Clone Wars film ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Nightsisters" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 20,35,1; per-sentence approximate match (5/5 sentences matched, min 0.60), verify]

Ruul [3]
- Killed Mira, ambushed Rhad Tarn, wounded Jedi Master K'Kruhk, and used psychological manipulation to turn Rhad toward the dark side. She briefly dueled Mace Windu, realized she was no match for his Vaapad, and fled with Sora Bulq.
  Source: Jedi: Mace Windu [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 3; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.90), verify]

Queyta [22]
- Fought Obi-Wan Kenobi's strike team over the antidote. After Jedi Master Fay had been beaten and left without her lightsaber, Ventress stabbed Fay in the back with both blades, mortally wounding her. She then left Kenobi hanging from a cliff rather than kill him.
  Source: Republic 53 [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 22; per-sentence approximate match (2/3 sentences matched, min 0.71), verify]

Duel with Darrus Jeht [23]
- Shot down Jeht's Delta-6 starfighter, wounded him across the chest, cut through his crashed fighter with her lightsabers, and later stabbed him through the ribs and lungs. Jeht's Force push/storm pinned and shocked her; he was rescued, and Ventress reported the mission as a success because Dooku's objective was to push Jeht toward the dark side.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Muunilinst / Yavin IV [24][25][26][27][28]
- During the Battle of Muunilinst, destroyed every fighter in Blue Squadron and survived a dogfight with Anakin Skywalker [25][26].
  Source: Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 10" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 25; approximate match 0.79, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- On Yavin IV, destroyed Skywalker's starfighter and the clone squad sent to help him, then fought him through the jungle and a Massassi temple. Skywalker gave in to rage, injured her left hand, took one saber, and knocked her from the temple pinnacle; she survived, wounded [24][28].
  Source: Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 19" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 28; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.72), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]

Ord Cestus [29]
- Rendered Trillot's best bodyguard Remlout moribund and spasmodic through the Force without being touched. She used Quy'Tek concealment around Jedi, trapped Kenobi and Kit Fisto, wounded Fisto in the arm, and fought Kenobi underwater; she escaped by releasing black ink.
  Source: The Cestus Deception [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 29; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.72), verify]
- She had ordered X'Ting attackers to engage the Jedi while she studied their movements, and executed Trillot after the operation.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Jabiim / Rattatak [7][31]
- Captured Obi-Wan Kenobi and Alpha-17 after Jabiim and took them to her castle for interrogation/torture. During the prison break, she killed Osika Kirske, but Kenobi stole Ky Narec's lightsaber and Ventress's starfighter.
  Source: Republic 55 ; Republic 58 ; Republic 60 [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 32,31,7; per-sentence approximate match (2/2 sentences matched, min 0.77), verify]

Rendili / Coruscant [30]
- Rode a rancor while pursuing Kenobi and Quinlan Vos. Later ambushed Anakin Skywalker, scarred his face, and claimed she could have taken his head. Skywalker defeated her by wrapping her in electric cables and throwing her into the lower levels; she barely survived.
  Source: Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 30; per-sentence approximate match (2/3 sentences matched, min 0.72), verify]

Christophsis [34]
- Used intelligence from clone sergeant Slick to set a surprise attack. In a violent duel, she fought Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker together; they kept her on the defensive and forced her to retreat, while her actual objective—delaying them so Slick could destroy a weapons depot—succeeded.
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "The Hidden Enemy" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 34; per-sentence approximate match (2/3 sentences matched, min 0.64), verify]

Teth [35][36]
- Held Jabba's son Rotta and used an edited recording to frame Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano as kidnappers. She dueled Kenobi but fled after he disarmed her of one saber. The article also says she later crossed blades with Jedi Master Bant Eerin and her Padawan [37].
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars novelization ; Star Wars The Clone Wars film ; The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 36,35,37; per-sentence approximate match (3/3 sentences matched, min 0.64), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]

Rugosa [38]
- After Yoda destroyed her droid army, Ventress failed to kill King Katuunko. Yoda froze her mid-swing and disarmed her, demonstrating superior Force skill; Ventress escaped by triggering an avalanche of boulders while Yoda held them back.
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Ambush" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 38; per-sentence approximate match (2/3 sentences matched, min 0.75), verify]

Kamino / Gwori [39][40][41]
- Her first Kamino operation failed when rookie clones destroyed the assault force and alerted the Republic. At Gwori, she executed Overseer Juhm on Dooku's order.
  Source: The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 41; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.61), verify]
- In the later Tipoca City assault, she killed ARC Trooper Commander Colt, fought Anakin over Jango Fett's DNA template, was defeated, and escaped aboard Grievous's vessel [39].
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Mon Gazza [42]
- Mortally wounded a senator, fought Ki-Adi-Mundi, destroyed the clone gunship, and fled. On the Mon Gazza Speedway, she fought Ahsoka Tano and was about to finish her when Anakin destroyed the datafile; Ventress cut a pod from San Maxus's racer, jumped to a vulture droid, and left Maxus for dead.
  Source: The Clone Wars: Crash Course [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 42; per-sentence approximate match (3/3 sentences matched, min 0.73), verify]

Khorm [43][44]
- Killed Jedi Knight Tauht, captured Captain Kendal Ozzel for information, injured Plo Koon's left arm by causing an avalanche, and sliced out Clone Commander Wolffe's right eye. She retreated after the Jedi destroyed the complex.
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 44; approximate match 0.82, verify]

Rescuing Gunray / Tranquility [8]
- Infiltrated the Jedi cruiser, planted explosives, killed clones, fought Ahsoka Tano, temporarily blinded Luminara Unduli by rupturing a coolant pipe, and defeated Luminara, trapping her under pipes. Ahsoka's Force push prevented the killing blow. Ventress then dueled both Jedi, escaped through the ventilation system, and killed Captain Faro Argyus after he claimed credit for her contribution.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Alzoc III / Behpour [45]
- Destroyed the remains of a Munificent-class frigate and faced Luminara Unduli and Aayla Secura on Alzoc III. At Behpour, she saved Dooku after he was wounded by Mace Windu and Obi-Wan Kenobi, then escaped with him.
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 45; per-sentence approximate match (2/2 sentences matched, min 0.97), verify]

Valahari [46]
- Secretly planted an explosive to frame Anakin Skywalker for Harko Vane's murder and briefly fought Obi-Wan Kenobi when he investigated.
  Source: The Clone Wars 11 [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 46; approximate match 0.94, verify]

Sullust / Dathomir / Dooku [1][47][48][49]
- During the Battle of Sullust, destroyed Skywalker's flagship Resolute. Sidious then ordered Dooku to eliminate her; she survived the command-ship destruction.
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Nightsisters" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 1; approximate match 0.80, verify]
- With Nightsisters Naa'leth and Karis, infiltrated Dooku's palace and poisoned him with a dart; Dooku defeated the attackers with Force lightning. Later, she and Savage Opress were still not strong enough to defeat Dooku, but in another encounter she blinded Dooku and escaped.
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Nightsisters" ; Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 7" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 1,13; per-sentence approximate match (2/3 sentences matched, min 0.60), verify]
- During Grievous's attack on the Nightsisters, she fought Grievous one-on-one and was wounded; the Nightsisters were annihilated.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Bounty hunter / Raydonia / Coruscant Underworld [50][52][54][55]
- As a bounty hunter, subdued a train attacker, rescued the captive girl and returned the hostages to their people. She later hunted Savage Opress, revived/rescued an imprisoned Obi-Wan Kenobi, and teamed with him against Darth Maul and Opress; the pair could not defeat them and retreated.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- In the Coruscant Underworld, subdued Ahsoka Tano and later helped her incapacitate a clone squad without killing anyone. The article notes this as a change in Ventress, quoting her that not killing people was “the new me.” When unarmed, she was subsequently subdued by Anakin's Force choke.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Vjun [10]
- Killed Jedi Padawan Jang Li-Li in a space dogfight and delivered the severed hand and damaged lightsaber to Dooku. Destroyed escort pilots, ambushed Yoda's decoy, and slew Jedi Masters Jai Maruk and Maks Leem at Phindar Station. The Yoda ambush failed; she was forced to retreat when faced with both Skywalker and Kenobi while injured.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

Boz Pity [6]
- After cybernetic modifications and a bacta-tank recovery, fought Kenobi and Skywalker. Dooku abandoned her; an IG-100 MagnaGuard shot her with a blaster rifle, and Anakin dealt her a mortal wound. She survived by entering a Sith trance and using Sith healing techniques, then escaped aboard the medical shuttle Bright Flight.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)

POWERS / ABILITIES — CONCRETE APPLICATIONS [11][13][15][20][22][24][29][35][44]
- Lightsaber: master of Jar'Kai; later applied paired-blade combat to Makashi and used the twin curved-hilt sabers as a saberstaff. The article says she could hold her own against up to three opponents, disarmed Kenobi early on Teth, and later fought/defeated General Grievous at least twice [3][29][49][64].
  Source: Jedi: Mace Windu ; The Cestus Deception ; Star Wars The Clone Wars film ; "Rogue's Gallery" — Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 3 ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Massacre" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 3,29,35,63,49,64; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.67), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Telekinesis/Force speed: collapsed large roof sections during her Rattatak initiation, used Force speed and Force Jump, caused a column to collapse on Dooku, and commanded flames aside on Yavin IV [15][13][24].
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Force control: lifted and choked Captain Rex; later choked/levitated both Anakin and Obi-Wan simultaneously; killed four pirates aboard the Raider with the power; used Affect Mind on Rex; commanded a rancor; attempted Force Crush on Fay; telekinetically stabbed Tauht; and used starblades [1][11][22][30][35][44].
  Source: Star Wars The Clone Wars film ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Nightsisters" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 35,1; per-sentence approximate match (3/3 sentences matched, min 0.67), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Concealment: learned to hide her Force signature and, after Dooku taught her advanced Quy'Tek meditations, could conceal herself near Jedi Council members and strike an unaware target [3][15][23][29].
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Esoteric powers: reanimated dead Gungans (identified by the article as resembling Tsaiwinokka Hoyakut), used Sith “lesser arts,” and used the Nightsister blood trail [11][20].
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
- Piloting: the article says she shot down numerous Republic starfighters within seconds at Muunilinst and survived a dogfight with Anakin [26].
  Source: Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 11" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 26; approximate match 0.75, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Unarmed combat: easily fought a group of Nightbrothers and later dodged Savage Opress's blows while striking him until Kenobi returned her lightsaber [47][52].
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Monster" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Revenge" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 47,52; approximate match 0.90, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]

ARTICLE-STATED SCALING / ASSESSMENTS (statements, not feats)
- Darth Sidious said her lightsaber skills were “most impressive” and called her a promising disciple; Dooku called her a “gifted assassin” [13][8]. These are character assessments, not standalone feats.
  Source: Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 7" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 13; per-sentence approximate match (1/2 sentences matched, min 0.72), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Ahsoka Tano told Luminara that Ventress was “too powerful for any one Jedi to fight alone” [8]. This is an in-universe statement.
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Cloak of Darkness" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 8; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says Ventress “may have been” Dooku's most powerful Dark Acolyte, with a Force connection “second only to” Dooku's [62][65]. The hedging is the article's wording.
  Source: The Official Star Wars Fact File 116 DOO 5-8: Count Dooku ; Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 55 [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 62,65; approximate match 0.73, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Obi-Wan Kenobi said that, had she not turned to the dark side, she could have been one of the greatest Jedi Masters of her era [7]. This is a hypothetical character statement.
  Source: Republic 60 [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 7; approximate match 0.85, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says Dooku felt Ventress growing stronger, and that Sidious feared that Ventress and Tyranus at their height could combine to destroy him [1][66]. This is scaling/hype stated by the article, not a feat of defeating Sidious.
  Source: The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 67 VEN 7-12: Asajj Ventress ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Nightsisters" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 66,1; approximate match 0.61, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Dooku said Ventress would be “more than a match for young Skywalker,” while Sidious said her success was not material to his plan [13]. These are predictions/assessments.
  Source: Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 7" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 13; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says her later dueling prowess let her battle/defeat or hold her own against Jedi Council masters, an accomplishment few contemporaries matched; it also says she eventually contended with and defeated Grievous at least twice [3][29][49][64]. These are article-level summaries; the named event details above are the concrete evidence it cites.
  Source: Jedi: Mace Windu ; The Cestus Deception ; Star Wars The Clone Wars film ; "Rogue's Gallery" — Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 3 ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Massacre" ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 3,29,35,63,49,64; per-sentence approximate match (2/3 sentences matched, min 0.67), verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article says Anakin considered her an exceptional pilot and describes him as one of the Jedi Order's greatest pilots [26]. This is an assessment, not a separate combat feat.
  Source: Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 11" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 26; approximate match 0.70, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]

LIMITATIONS / NEGATIVE EVIDENCE STATED BY THE ARTICLE
- Early in her career, she lacked the physical strength to compensate for Jar'Kai/Makashi weaknesses; Dooku casually defended her blows, and Anakin's offensive frenzy forced her retreat on Yavin IV [13][28].
  Source: Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 7" ; Star Wars: Clone Wars — "Chapter 19" [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 13,28; approximate match 0.65, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- Luminara called her Makashi “unrefined,” “amateurish,” and “sloppy”; Ventress was once heavily reliant on her second blade. The article says she later overcame that weakness, driving Plo Koon to a catwalk edge one-handed [8][35][44].
  Source: Star Wars: The Clone Wars — "Cloak of Darkness" ; Star Wars The Clone Wars film ; Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic [per Wookieepedia "Asajj Ventress/Legends" rev 15683810, ref 8,35,44; approximate match 0.83, verify; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- The article repeatedly records losses or escapes against Yoda, Dooku, Anakin, Kenobi, Grievous, and Maul/Opress; do not treat survival or retreat as a win.
  Source: UNRESOLVED (sentence not found in current Wookieepedia article revision; primary source not identified)
